summary: The diff implements all three requirements. REQ-1 is addressed by refactoring Jap.tsx to use useRef for stale-closure-free counting and fixing race conditions. REQ-2 is addressed by optimistic local state updates and debounced backend sync (1.5s). REQ-3 is addressed by adding a CircularProgress component with saffron/gold colors, 0–108 cycle, and count/target display. The index.css adds supporting animations. All existing visual effects (SacredRipple, OmParticleBurst, LotusBloomOverlay, MalaRing) are preserved per the imports visible in Jap.tsx. No missing requirements or hallucinated features are identified.
